name: med_dispenser
prompt: Freestanding medical serum dispenser cabinet from a sealed biotech research lab, 2 metres tall, grey-green painted steel body with brushed steel trim, frosted glass front window showing racks of small glass vials, a coloured glowing light strip above the window, dispensing tray slot at waist height, small keypad, scuffed paint, slight rust at the base.

name: reforger
prompt: Heavy industrial metal coating press from a sealed biotech lab, waist-high steel workbench about 1.6 metres long with a hinged clamshell lid over a long tray big enough for a rifle, thick hydraulic pistons, hoses and small pressure gauges, a glass tank of pale glowing green liquid metal on one side, dark gunmetal body with worn orange hazard paint, grime, thin dark moss-like organic growth creeping over the pipes.

name: power_switch
prompt: Wall-standing emergency backup generator breaker cabinet, grey steel electrical cabinet 1.8 metres tall with its door open, one big knife switch lever with a dark red handle on the front, rows of old breakers and round dials, thick conduit pipes rising from the top, faded worn hazard orange and black warning stripes, scuffed and dented.

name: exfil_hatch
prompt: Square heavy steel emergency escape hatch set flush into a thin concrete floor slab, 3 by 3 metres, flat closed blast lid almost level with the slab, a central wheel lock, recessed grab handles, worn hazard orange and black hazard stripe border, heavy bolts, grime and scratches.

name: office_chair_tipped
prompt: Swivel office chair from a 1990s research facility lying tipped over on its side, grey fabric seat, black plastic base with castors.

name: lab_cart
prompt: Wheeled stainless steel lab cart with two shelves, steel trays, a few empty glass beakers and a clipboard, scuffed castors.

name: supply_shelving
prompt: Grey steel warehouse shelving unit 2 metres tall, four shelves with cardboard boxes, plastic tubs and folded blankets, a few boxes fallen and torn.

name: tool_cart
prompt: Engineer's red-brown rolling tool chest with drawers half open, wrenches and a hand lamp on top, oily and worn.

name: gas_cylinder_rack
prompt: Steel rack holding four tall grey gas cylinders chained upright, one cylinder missing, valves and regulators, scuffed paint.

name: biohazard_bin
prompt: Wheeled grey plastic medical waste bin with a hinged lid half open, hazard orange band, stained and dirty.

name: wheelchair
prompt: Old steel hospital wheelchair with a cracked black vinyl seat, folded footrests, worn and dusty.

name: janitor_cart
prompt: Janitor cleaning cart with a mop bucket on wheels, a mop leaning in it, spray bottles, a grey trash bag, worn.

name: fire_hose_cabinet
prompt: Wall-mounted steel fire hose cabinet with its glass door open, coiled canvas hose on a reel, dark red paint faded and chipped.

name: server_rack_tipped
prompt: Black steel server rack cabinet tipped over on its side, door hanging open, loose cables and a few computer units spilling out.

name: riot_shield_cases
prompt: Black security riot shield lying on the floor with a scatter of brass spent bullet casings and an empty rifle magazine next to it.

name: water_cooler
prompt: Office water cooler with an empty cracked plastic bottle on top, grey and off-white body, a stack of paper cups.
